title: Knowledge-freshness close door: fix required_context resolution, scope to touched areas, repair areas/ pointers
action: Per plan v2 C1 (D1). (1) Fix the generator/check mismatch: check.rs:542-563 resolves required_context only inside the bundle, but promote.rs:549-554 writes docs/history/<f>/CONTEXT.md+plan.md there — resolve required_context against the bundle FIRST, then the repo root (dir.parent().parent() as dangling_source already does at check.rs:574-588); a docs/history path that exists on disk is not dangling. (2) New build_knowledge_freshness_door in close.rs: filter check warnings post-walk to prefixes areas/<touched>/ (touched_bundle_areas, close.rs:895-918) + work/<feature>/; dangling_source + dangling_required_context in scope => blocking:true with per-file remedy detail; not_canonical/invalid_evidence_state stay report-only in detail. Deferral escape shaped like has_capture_deferral_decision (close.rs:663-676): a decision citing knowledge-freshness + the feature defers with reason in detail. Slot the door after pattern-check in the exit chain (close.rs:1266 precedent) and into all three doors vecs (close.rs:1061, 1111, 1188). (3) Repair the 6 existing areas/ dangling sources listed in files[] — each names a retired path; point to the live Rust equivalent or remove the entry with a one-line reason in place. Tests in drivers/tests.rs: dangling source in touched area refuses close; same warning in untouched area is clear; deferral decision makes it non-blocking with named reason; no bundle => door absent; a promoted delivery file whose required_context names docs/history paths resolves clean after (1).

truths: bee knowledge check reports zero dangling_required_context after the resolution fix (all 13 current ones resolve via repo root)
close refuses when a touched area holds a dangling_source and names the file and remedy
a recorded deferral decision demotes the door to non-blocking with the reason in the detail line
the 6 areas/ dangling_source warnings are gone

trace.outcome: Added the knowledge-freshness close door and fixed check.rs's required_context resolution (bundle-first-then-repo-root); repaired the 6 dangling areas/ sources.
trace.inline_reason: cell was claimed under trace.worker=orchestrator by the dispatching session before delegating to execution worker kdt1-worker (now registered in state.json workers[]); kdt1-worker performed the implementation, tests, and this cap

checks.evidence: Ran `.bee/bin/bee knowledge check --json` on the live tree: counts.warnings=7, every warning code is not_canonical or invalid_evidence_state — zero dangling_required_context, zero dangling_source. Binary is post-fix (`strings .bee/bin/bee | rg -c 'does not resolve inside the bundle or at the repo root'` = 1). Fix is packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/knowledge/check.rs:552-559 (bundle-first, then `repo_root.map(|root| root.join(s).exists())`, repo_root defined check.rs:286). Unit proof: `bee-dbbd56077b8a9375 history_anchor_required_context` -> verbs::drivers::tests::check_bundle_resolves_a_history_anchor_required_context_at_the_repo_root ... ok (1 passed). The specific pre-fix count of 13 was not independently re-measured; the post-fix zero is observed.

packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/close.rs:1398-1420 returns exit 1 with `{CLOSE_KNOWLEDGE_FRESHNESS_PREFIX} "<feature>" — close stops at the knowledge-freshness door: <detail>` plus the remedy line; detail items are built at close.rs:733-741 as `{file}: {message} — remedy: point the pointer at its live target, or remove the entry with a one-line reason`, scoped to `areas/<touched>/` + `work/<feature>/` prefixes (close.rs:722-726). Ran prebuilt test binary: verbs::drivers::tests::close_refuses_at_the_knowledge_freshness_door ... ok and knowledge_freshness_door_blocks_on_a_dangling_source_in_a_touched_area ... ok (5 passed, 0 failed).

close.rs has_knowledge_freshness_deferral_decision returns the deferring decision's own text (tag knowledge-freshness-deferral + feature filter), and the door emits `deferred — N stale pointer(s) ... : <reason>` with blocking:false. Ran: verbs::drivers::tests::knowledge_freshness_door_deferral_decision_demotes_to_non_blocking_with_the_reason ... ok (asserts detail starts_with "deferred —" and contains the decision text).

`git show --stat e79eca74` lists 5 docs/knowledge/areas/*.md files, each +1/-1; capture-queue-and-the-blocker-threshold.md repoints TWO retired paths in one sources line (status_full/orient.rs:134-181 -> state.rs, status_full/records.rs:215 -> drivers/close.rs), so 5 files carry the 6 repaired pointers. Live `.bee/bin/bee knowledge check --json` reports zero dangling_source warnings across 250 files / 222 concepts.

close.rs:743 match arm `"not_canonical" | "invalid_evidence_state" => report_only_count += 1` — these codes are only counted, never pushed to blocking_items, and the door returns blocking:false with `clear — N report-only finding(s) ... never block` when blocking_items is empty (close.rs:747-758). Live corroboration: the repo currently holds 7 warnings, all of those two codes, and `bee knowledge check` is the door's own source. No dedicated unit test asserts this arm; the code path is unambiguous.
